observations.text: Re-review delta at commit 0bc44df. ARGV: git diff --name-only a3d69f9 0bc44df; exit 0; stdout: the five production files of the craft (crates/ports/src/review.rs, crates/review-domain/src/repo_scope/{resume.rs,mod.rs}, crates/adapter-review-store/src/{scan_runs.rs,purge.rs}, crates/openlore-review-app/src/scan.rs), the feature docs and run records, and tests/acceptance/review_app_repos_read_across_resume.rs. The oracle file is again the only changed test file; the declared supports and the test manifest are byte-identical to the revisions I reviewed at ca0db1f and a3d69f9. Production is now built, so this round judges the oracle delta against an implemented system, not a missing one. Tree clean at 0bc44df.

ARGV: cargo test -p openlore-review-app --test review_app_repos_read_across_resume; exit 0; stdout: 7 passed, 0 failed in 3.48 s, naming a_run_picking_a_paused_scan_up_keeps_every_repo_the_scan_already_read, a_run_picking_a_paused_scan_up_does_not_read_a_repo_the_scan_already_read, a_run_picks_up_repos_of_the_plan_it_was_given_and_no_others, a_scan_picked_up_after_a_pause_accounts_for_the_repos_of_the_whole_scan, a_scan_picked_up_twice_accounts_for_every_repo_it_read_along_the_way and the two support self-tests. The two journeys whose semantic RED I measured at a3d69f9 (left 2 right 3, left 1 right 3) are now green against the built production, which is the completion obligation I retained.

The retained L3 finding is answered, and answered at the right place. sut_picked_up now reads verdict.kept() and maps KeptRow.status == PlanRowStatus::Read onto carries_an_earlier_read, so the flag carries production's answer instead of a literal: production owns already_read and gives kept() its three shares (crates/review-domain/src/repo_scope/resume.rs:107-124). a_run_picks_up_repos_of_the_plan_it_was_given_and_no_others now takes its positions from that kept plan rather than from to_read, so the carried share that nothing observed at a3d69f9 is inside the within-the-plan, plan-order and each-position-once assertion. The new L1 property keeps its expected value independent of production: already_read(&paused.plan) is computed from the generated plan alone, and the generator a_paused_scan_with_reads_to_keep always plants an already-read row, one of its three shapes from a source whose account fails its check now and which the owner has removed since.

I observed the new property's RED myself under a temporary production mutation, of the kind the design names as the wrong behaviour. Mutation: in crates/review-domain/src/repo_scope/resume.rs, PlanRowStatus::Read => resume.already_read.push(position) became a push guarded by !removed.contains(&row.source), so an already-read row of a removed source is dropped from the verdict. ARGV: cargo test -p openlore-review-app --test review_app_repos_read_across_resume -- a_run_picking_a_paused_scan_up_keeps_every_repo_the_scan_already_read; exit 101; stdout: FAILED, left {2} right {1, 2}, with proptest shrinking to a minimal failing plan. The property therefore falsifies the exact loss it exists to forbid, and is not green for free. Restored with git checkout -- crates/review-domain/src/repo_scope/resume.rs; the proptest regression file the failure wrote was removed; git status --porcelain is empty; ARGV: cargo test -p openlore-review-app --test review_app_repos_read_across_resume; exit 0; 7 passed in 3.86 s, so the restoration is observed, not assumed.

Closure over the manifest at 0bc44df: P1 and P2 are each observed by two public journeys and three domain properties, L5/F120 and L4/F116 on the one-pause journey, L1 and L4/F115 on the twice-paused one, L1/F101 on the new property, L2/F107, L3/F111, T1 on cargo xtask check-arch and L4/F117 on the existing adapter purge test. No obligation is left without a falsifier and no test repeats another's observation. Timing: 3.48 s and 3.86 s wall for 7 tests with two HTTP journeys, the share ADR-091 accepts for this family; nothing sits near half of its budget, so no nine-run median evidence was collected. typesafe: unavailable, carried from the probe recorded this session (TYPESAFE_API_KEY absent from this process environment, unchanged); every judgment here is locally derived from the measured runs and the read bytes.

diagnostic: Accepted, with no finding left open. The retained L3 finding is resolved: sut_picked_up now reads verdict.kept() and carries KeptRow.status == Read into the flag, so the answer comes from production and not from a literal, and the plan-never-grows property takes its positions from that kept plan, which is where the carried share lives. The new L1/F101 property observes the one thing no journey could reach broadly - that a repo this scan already read stays read whatever its account answers now and whoever removed its source since - and I observed its RED myself: guarding the already_read push with !removed.contains(&row.source) in resume_plan reddens it at left {2} right {1, 2} with a shrunk failing plan, and after restoring the file the suite is green again at 7 passed, with the tree clean and the regression file removed. The whole oracle is green against the built production, including the two journeys whose semantic RED I measured at a3d69f9, so the completion obligation I retained then is met. Every obligation of the manifest keeps a falsifier and none duplicates another. No design, implementation or product finding; nothing in this delta blocks craft or completion.
